title: Item:Turret Requisition

[[File:Turret Requisition store icon.png]][[File:Turret Requisition orb.png]]
[[File:Turret Requisition.png|thumb|420px|Turret Requisition]] [[File:Turret Requisition store.png|thumb|Turret Requisition in the DDO Store]] Use this requisition form to gain access to another defense turret that can be placed where you want to defend your extractors. Usable in extraction challenges. If you have 5 turrets active or in your inventory and you try to purchase a 6th, the extractors will ask you for that requisition form. Acquired by: * {{Verified|Killing boss monsters in any challenge. (~4-5% chance for them to drop a random challenge item)}}, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}. * Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear and Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}. Usable in the following extraction challenges: * [[Kobold Island: Kobold Chaos]] * [[Kobold Island: The Disruptor]] * [[Kobold Island: The Disruptor - EPIC]] * [[Kobold Island: Short Cuts]] * [[Kobold Island: Short Cuts - EPIC]] ==See also== * [[Challenges]] * [[DDO Store]] - Challenge Tools [[Category:DDO Store items]] [[Category:Challenge items]]
